views.label: Add new primary
views.note: The admin redeems terms that the new primary signed for the existing bucket. expected_version pins the provider's terms.

views.label: Move the data
views.note: The client downloads from a provider that has the data and uploads to the new primary.

views.label: Checkpoint and expiry
views.note: The new primary signs a checkpoint while the old one is still bound. The old agreement ends at expiry; there is no early end.

segments.label: Add the new primary to the bucket
Checkpoint, then let the old agreement expire

messages.label: checkpoint with the new primary's signature
AgreementEnded or AgreementExpiredClaimed; removed from primary_providers

cards.title: No downtime
items: Both primaries are in bucket.primary_providers until the old agreement ends
The new primary signs a checkpoint while the old one is still bound
Each checkpoint replaces primary_signers with its own signers and needs min_providers on its own
The bucket's slot layout must stay within MaxPrimarySlots; a virtual provider takes one slot per member
The quote contains no price or version; expected_version fails the call with ProviderVersionMismatch if the provider's terms changed

cards.title: The client moves the data
items: Primaries do not sync with each other
A client that keeps a local copy only uploads; otherwise the change costs a full download and a full upload
Provider-to-provider fetch is a Future Direction; today the new primary gets the data only from the client

cards.title: Removing the old primary
items: The agreement is binding: no early end by the admin or the provider. The admin lets it expire
After expires_at the owner calls end_agreement with EndAction::Pay or Burn within SettlementTimeout; after that the provider calls claim_expired_agreement
An open challenge against the old primary blocks neither call: the challenge contains what its resolution needs

cards.title: Virtual providers: replacement agreement
items: create_replacement(bucket_id, provider, additional_duration, expected_version) (owner only, NotVirtual otherwise) stores a pending successor: new agreement_id, current member set, stake snapshot

The new member set syncs and signs. The first checkpoint with activate_replacements (primary) or confirm_replica_sync with activate_replacement (replica) activates it; the old agreement settles as an extension would
If the old agreement expires first the successor lapses: ReplacementExpired, its payment is released to the owner
While pending, extend_agreement and top_up_agreement are rejected and there is no cancel
